title: Architecture for Simulating Behavior Mode Changes in Norm-Aware Autonomous Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of norm-aware autonomous agents using Answer Set Programming (ASP). While it discusses 'norms' and 'norm-compliance,' these are treated as logical policy constraints within a robotic simulation (e.g., mining tasks) rather than as a study of human morality, religion, or ethics. Additionally, it does not involve Large Language Models.
